output.narrative: An unknown adversary breached this Windows system using an initial access vector involving the download of malware via `certutil`. The downloaded executable established communication with its command-and-control server (`https://124.223.85.207`). Further commands were executed through PowerShell scripts with bypassed execution policies, facilitating lateral movement within the network (`http://121.36.30.176`, `\\192.168.0.95`), credential collection attempts (`administrator_pass.txt`) and privilege escalation (`registry modification`). Modifications to registry keys allowed persistence (`Debugger key modifications`). A final stage involved defense evasion tactics (`sethc.exe` debugger configuration).
